title: tcc vars
description: Configuration variables for the Tiny C Compiler (TCC) recipe

TCC_VERSION.description: Version of Tiny C Compiler (TCC) to install or build.

TCC_INSTALL_METHOD.description: Installation strategy for TCC ('system' via package manager, 'from-source' compiled from source, or 'libscript_native').

TCC_PKG_MGR.description: Specific package manager to use when installing TCC (e.g., apt-get, apk, dnf, brew, pacman, winget, choco, scoop, nix, spack).

TCC_BUILD_TOOLCHAIN.description: Bootstrap C toolchain used when TCC_INSTALL_METHOD='from-source' ('default', 'gcc', 'clang', 'custom-cc').

TCC_DOWNLOAD_URL.description: Explicit source tarball or archive URL for TCC.

TCC_GIT_URL.description: Git repository URL for building TCC from source.

TCC_CFLAGS.description: Default compiler flags exported when using TCC.
